violation_type.title: Heating Devices Safe - No Access By Children (26 TAC §747.5301(d))
violation_type.short_title: Heating Devices Safe - No Access By Children
violation_type.typical_finding: The space heater in the restroom did not have any safeguard and was not mounted to keep it from being accessible to children. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the space heater.
